card.summary: S. 3897, the Officer John Barnes and Chief Michael Ansbro Public Safety Officers' Benefit Program Expansion Act of 2026, revises administrative procedures for the Public Safety Officers' Benefits (PSOB) program. It establishes processing timelines, requires interim benefit payments if deadlines are missed, mandates the use of subpoenas to obtain overdue agency records, requires ongoing outreach to public safety officers and underserved agencies, mandates the implementation of specific GAO recommendations, and requires annual audits of claims pending for more than one year.
